questions.prompt: Which mental model best explains “Destructuring List and Map Values” in Dart Sass?
options: Readable SCSS guarantees correct browser rendering, accessibility, and performance without output review.

questions.prompt: Which review decision most directly supports maintainability for “Destructuring List and Map Values”?

Generate every possible selector or theme combination, even when most variants are never used.
Treat successful compilation as proof that the interface is accessible and behaves correctly in every browser.

questions.explanation: Bound the data you iterate over, validate configuration before generating selectors, and inspect both selector names and output size.
